buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses IMPORTANT POINTS FOR BIDDERS 1. EMD: Submit EMD of Rs. 20,00,000 through prescribed BG/e-BG or IRDAI-regulated Insurance Surety Bon d. DD, cheque, cash and money order are not acceptable. 2. Original EMD: Upload the scanned EMD with the online bid and deposit the original within 5 HPCL workin g days after the GeM bid end date at Tender Box No. 7, CPO, Marathon Futurex, Lower Parel, Mumbai - 400 013.

3. EMD exemption: Eligible exempt bidders must upload the prescribed Bid Securing Declaration. MSE tra ders are not eligible for EMD exemption. 4. Bid validity: Keep the bid valid for 120 days. A shorter validity may lead to rejection. 5. No price in technical bid: Do not mention or indicate any rate/price in the Techno-Commercial Bid. Quo te prices only in the designated GeM Price Bid. 6. Integrity Pact: Submit the duly filled and signed Integrity Pact. Non-submission may lead to rejection. 7. PQC/BQC: Meet every mandatory financial and technical qualification criterion and submit complete sup porting documents. 8. Experience evidence: For live deployment across three customer touchpoints, submit client-issued con firmation covering touchpoint names, go-live dates and operational modules. Work Order and Completion Certificate alone are not sufficient. 9. OEM documents: Submit mandatory OEM credentials, live-deployment evidence and OEM Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF). Quote only one OEM solution. 10. Data localization certificate: Submit a valid and current Data Localization Compliance Certificate issue d by an independent CERT-In empanelled auditor. Provisional or under-process documents are not accepta ble. 11. Technical compliance: Answer every technical requirement with Yes/No and supporting remarks/eviden ce. A No against any mandatory requirement may cause rejection. 12. Live demonstration: Demonstrate all mandatory features in the offered production-ready solution. Futu re roadmap commitments will not replace live functionality. 13. Technical score: Secure at least 75 marks out of 100 to qualify for opening of the financial bid. 14. Complete quotation: Quote for all line items and the complete scope. Part quotation, alternate offers an d multiple bids are not permitted. 15. Make in India: Only Class-I and Class-II Local Suppliers are eligible. Submit the prescribed local-content d eclaration/certificate. 16. Forms and declarations: Submit all applicable Forms 1 to 12, including bidder information, eligibility, te chnical/PQC compliance, EMD documents, GST and non-blacklisting declarations. 17. Authorised signatory: Enclose valid Power of Attorney, Board Resolution or other authorization for the p erson signing the bid. 18. Document quality: Upload clear, legible, duly signed documents. PDF files must not be password-protec ted. 19. No material deviations: Do not submit conditional offers or substantive deviations from scope, delivery, firm price, security, Integrity Pact or other critical conditions. 20. Portal monitoring: Regularly check the GeM portal for corrigenda, clarifications and extensions, and sub mit the bid well before the deadline. Important: Bidders should submit a complete bid at the first instance and should not rely on p ost-bid clarification to cure substantive eligibility or qualification deficiencies. . 5.
